name: WindPvP
description:
Hello everyone!

I've been working on a Minecraft server that is very different from most of the ones you see.

Instead of the typical Minecraft survival experience, we aim to provide competitive minigames, many of which are classic gamemodes that have since been shut down. Currently, we have:

Capture the Flag - once found on MCPVP/Brawl

KitPvP - inspired by LemonCloud's old KitPvP gamemode

Duels - custom coded game

I'm looking for feedback to see how I can improve and grow the server! If you have the time, I would greatly appreciate any thoughts or advice.

IP: mps.windpvp.com

You can find a quick guide here: windpvp.com/wiki/welcome

And let me know what you think on our Discord server! discord.gg/yV4BdtbtxU

Thanks!
